environment: local production preview, headless Chromium via agent-browser, synthetic one-flight fixture, isolated browser session
method: Browser performance.now() from DOM click to an explicit ready predicate, sampled with requestAnimationFrame. Map projection generated with the 5,000-pair shape in apps/next/tests/performance.bench.ts and returned through a session-local fetch override; no persistent data changed.

passport.countrySheetNote: The round trip includes the specified 300 ms close animation.

map5000Pairs.note: Map timings include MapLibre initialization and rendering in one Chromium environment. They do not represent real 5,000-flight data, network latency, or a range of devices.

mobileJournal.keyboardNote: Headless desktop Chromium did not open a virtual keyboard when the mobile filter input was focused, so keyboard-driven tab-bar behavior was not measured.

leaderboardDrill.note: One isolated 102 ms frame occurred in the first six normal-direction samples and did not recur in eight additional samples; cause not established. Reduced-motion Back includes Next history restoration.

sourceSuspects: The map Routes/Frequency view creates one DOM list item per projected pair: 5,000 in this probe.
renderer.tsx computes routeGeometry for every route in FlightRoutes and again for Controls bounds; MapLibre then receives one batched GeoJSON source.
AirportLayer can derive and project up to 10,000 distinct endpoints when its labels update on map movement.
unmeasured: Map stress on low-end physical hardware
